description: A host without Windows must supply Arial (arial.ttf) and Arial Italic (ariali.ttf): GDI resolves Arial Bold / Times New Roman Bold / Comic Sans MS Bold to them (S5.1 U-1501) and they are not in the install. Metric-compatible substitutes (for example Liberation Sans) were not measured: the widths equality of S5.1 is proven for the Windows files only.
path to resolution: Measure widths_check with SG_FONT_DIR pointing at a directory holding the substitute faces.
